event.title: fix(skills): remove local install scanner
event.body:
## Summary

- Remove the local dangerous-code scanner from skill install paths.
- Keep plugin install/update scanning unchanged.
- Document the skill install trust model: ClawHub uses registry-side security signals; non-ClawHub installs are trusted-by-operator paths.

## Rationale

The local skill scanner is regex-based, creates friction and false confidence, and does not match the intended product direction. ClawHub security should rely on registry-side ClawScan/security signals, while non-ClawHub skill installs remain an explicit operator trust decision.

This also resolves the ambiguity around ClawHub's previous `scan: false` path by making the policy explicit across all skill install paths instead of preserving a partial local scanner for only some non-ClawHub paths.

## Future work

Add a configurable pre-skill-install hook for enterprise policy/scanning integrations such as ClawScan, Snyk agent scanning, signatures, or custom scanners.

## Verification

```text
pnpm test src/skills/lifecycle/install.test.ts src/skills/lifecycle/archive-install.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/skills-upload.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/skills.clawhub.test.ts src/skills/lifecycle/source-install.test.ts
```

```text
OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 CI=1 PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false pnpm check:changed
```

```text
git diff --check
```

Note: plain `pnpm check:changed` attempted to delegate to Blacksmith Testbox, but the local Crabbox binary is `0.20.0` and the current Testbox workflow requires `>=0.22.0`. The local child-mode changed check above passed.
